programme_title: Application of remote sensing, GIS in official statistics
topic: Remote sensing, GIS, GPS, digital image processing, geospatial technology and alternate data sources for official statistics
content: Concept of remote sensing with GIS mapping and tools of disaster management, UFS applications. Basics of GIS, GPS and their operations, Digital Image Processing, Multi Criteria Analysis using GIS, Smart sampling using geospatial technology, Crop Acreage Estimation using geospatial technology, Space Technology Applications in Crop Cutting Experiment, GIS Analysis of Census Data, Geo-spatial Technology applications in smart Governance, UAV Remote Sensing Applications, Exposure to alternate data sources like scanner data, mobile data, GIS, nightlight data, web-scrapped data etc and its use for policy formulation
proposed_institute: Indian Institute of Remote Sensing (IIRS), Dehradun / National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) Hyderabad / Space Applications Centre (SAC) Ahmedabad / NESAC, Meghalaya
